assumptions.landedBinding: The port is rooted at the director-supplied accepted base; the shadow base is provenance only.
Product Assurance owns the 103-scenario canonical fault denominator; A5 keeps a distinct 120-case synthetic hostile corpus and creates no canonical fault owner.
Product Assurance owns failure-atlas projection and validation; A5 creates no atlas, projector, or second failure-record store.

Product Assurance owns diagnostic proposal evaluation, forbidden capabilities, provider-outage projection, evidence redaction, and validation of injected privacy/retention evidence; Ledger and external retention owners remain authoritative for durable retention.
Product Assurance owns deterministic remediation vocabulary, transitions, atomic resource acquisition, and lease fencing; A5 creates no executor.
The existing Ledger remains sole durable-history owner; A5 contains fixtures and tests only and requests any future adapter through AIOPS-IR-PERSISTENCE-003.
The landed Product Integration projection explicitly reports INCIDENT_OWNER_NOT_CONFIGURED; A5 does not synthesize incident authority.

System Integration owns the canonical trace-event-kind denominator and has no AI_OPS kind; Product Integration only validates and projects persisted material-event pages. A5 requests any future addition through AIOPS-IR-EVENTS-009.

SystemControlService remains canonical command authority; Product Integration exposes a narrow adapter and exactly four fail-safe controls. A5 requests any future AI_OPS namespace through AIOPS-IR-CONTROLS-008.
A5 conformance uses the landed READY, NOT_CONFIGURED, and UNAVAILABLE diagnostic-provider contract; synthetic campaign provider labels are not canonical runtime state.
Independent sentinel, notification delivery, WORM export, credential proxy, release canary, rollback, and approval mounts remain outside A5 evidence and are insertion requests only.
Root package scripts do not discover the exclusive A5 roots; AIOPS-IR-TEST-MOUNT-026 is the only requested shared-seam change.

The 120-case corpus is synthetic and non-authoritative; real port evidence is limited to direct landed-owner conformance, deterministic replay, total-network-deny execution, and the immutable port receipt.
